title: Paper Towel Holder - 15.5-Inch Wall Mount Powder Coated Iron Pipe Style, Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Free up countertop space and keep paper towels right where you need them—this wall-mounted holder is protected with a highly durable powder coat and backed by a limited lifetime warranty.

  • Maintains a clean, decorative finish with powder coated iron pipe construction
  • Resists corrosion and rust for dependable everyday use
  • Pairs easily with matching pipeline, pipe-style accessories from the Pipeline collection
